summary: Master predictive sales analytics, churn prediction, and CLV modeling. Learn to forecast revenue and optimize marketing ROI with data-driven precision. Enroll.
lede: Predictive Analytics for Sales and Marketing helps you move beyond descriptive reporting by using historical data, statistical algorithms, and machine learning to anticipate customer and sales outcomes. This five-day intensive course develops practical skills in customer segmentation, sales forecasting, attribution modeling, and lead scoring. You will learn to build data pipelines, validate predictive models with RMSE, and turn insights into next-best-action strategies for sales teams. The course also introduces multi-channel attribution and the use of large language models for sentiment analysis, helping you apply predictive methods in complex business environments.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-to-advanced program is tailored for professionals who manage data-intensive commercial functions and are responsible for revenue growth.
audience: CRM Strategists focused on customer retention
modules: Sentiment Analysis and NLP for Sales
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of sales/marketing KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROI) and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot) and basic statistical concepts (mean, correlation) is recommended. No prior coding experience is required, though exposure to SQL or Python is beneficial.
